metadata.title: A note on coupled Dirac-harmonic maps
metadata.abstract: We construct coupled Dirac-harmonic maps from manifolds of the form $S^1\times M$ where $M$ is a spin manifold equipped with a pair of harmonic spinors satisfying a norm condition. This method produces coupled Dirac-harmonic maps from closed manifolds.
